//: Capability manifest for <Sparkline> — svelte-pure-admin (display/Sparkline.svelte). See heatmap.map.json for the model. Scope: the pa-sparkline block (inline-flex row + data-driven pa-sparkline__bar children). `values` is a data list rendered as pa-sparkline__bar divs, each carrying the inline style --value: N% (the oracle/keen shape); svelte also accepts a hand-authored <SparklineBar> `children` snippet when values is omitted, out of scope here. variant is success|warning|danger|info (the four CSS-backed bar ramps); primary/default emits no modifier. size is sm|lg.
